### 🧪 Pre-Merge Checklist

Please ensure the following checks pass before requesting a review:

- [ ] Code follows the project style guide and is formatted (`npm run format:check` or `npm run format`)
- [ ] No TypeScript compiler errors (`npm run type-check`)
- [ ] Linter passes with 0 warnings/errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Unit tests pass cleanly (`npm test`)
- [ ] Production build succeeds (`npm run build`)
- [ ] **NO secrets, credentials, or API keys are committed in this PR**
